searchText: am i correct to assume that a node is not syncing if it has a `sync_distance` of `0` according to this API endpoint: https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Node/getSyncingStatus ? lighthouse returns an explicit `is_syncing` flag, seems like teku does not but i'm guessing the previous stmt holds I like having an explicit flag but it wasn't in the spec. Would quite happily add it to Teku if there was agreement. I really dislike having to infer it from sync_distance. Teku does explicitly set sync distance to 0 if we're not syncing regardless of how far behind the current slot our best block is. ie sync_distance will be 0 even if the current slot was empty. makes sense, i'll just use "syncing? : sync_distance != 0" for now although lighthouse may use sync_distance of 1 while they transition to the next block.... i'd +1 a reliable way to know if a node is "syncing" or not
